title: Fideon canonical schema - commercial_fire (policy_check)
description: SPEC_21 section 4 canonical schema for commercial_fire, commercial fire (L1 code commercial_fire), composing common_model.json 1.1.0 by $ref: the envelope plus the locations and buildings blocks the property lines use. Built from the seven single-LOB 'Commercial Fire and Liability' declarations of the source data (one carrier, read in place). A commercial fire policy insures the building and business property against named perils (Section I) and grants premises liability and medical payments beside them (Section II); both are coverages of this line. No LOB block.
fideon:status: SPEC_21 schema of a new line (10 October 2026): the project owner ruled that the 'Commercial Fire and Liability' product is a line of business of its own (CR-BOPPR-06) and approved new canonical schemas. Built from 7 seed documents of 1 carrier; the seed golds drafted against it are DRAFT, pending reviewer sign-off.

corpora: synth_core/fideon/synth_core/data/source data/<Carrier>/{boppr,prop,cgl_prop}/ (7 documents printing 'DECLARATION, Commercial Fire and Liability', seeds)

fideon:lob_block: None. Every concept the seeds print has a home in the envelope or a common-model building block (SPEC_21 4.2.4). The liability rows of Section II (Coverage L, M, the LS-49 personal injury option) are coverages of this line: Coverage M uses the shared X_MED_PAY; Coverage L and LS-49 use CF_ codes until the shared liability codes of CR-BOPPR-01 exist (CHANGE_REQUESTS_commercial_fire.md CR-CFIRE-01). The OLT classification premiums are premium.items of those coverages.
fideon:audit_rules: premium.total == sum(coverages[].premium) + sum(forms_and_endorsements[].premium) + sum(premium.items[].amount) + sum(premium.surcharges[].amount) + sum(premium.discounts[].amount) + sum(premium.taxes_fees[].amount) ± 0.01
fideon:audit_rules_note: Rules 1-4 are common_model.json fideon:default_audit_rules (the claims-made rule left out: a commercial fire declarations prints no retroactive date). Rule 5: an each-occurrence liability limit never exceeds its aggregate. Rule 6: the medical payments each-person limit never exceeds the each-accident limit. Rule 7 holds on all 7 seeds: exclusion credits are negative form premiums, a premium printed 'Incl.' parses to null and adds nothing, and the carrier's printed subtotals ('Property Total', 'Coverage Premium') are additional_fields, not premium items. A rule whose values a document does not print is not evaluated.
